summary.tldr: Authorizes up to $108.7 billion for federal public administration spending for 2023-24.
what_it_does: Authorizes up to $108,700,157,669 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for federal public administration expenses in the 2023-24 fiscal year that are not otherwise provided for.
Splits the money into $103,446,347,749 for Schedule 1 items and $5,253,809,920 for Schedule 2 items, after subtracting interim amounts already granted under Appropriation Act No. 1, 2023-24.
Limits each item to its stated purpose and any terms and conditions in the item.
Makes the item provisions effective as of April 1, 2023.
Allows some amounts in Schedules 1 and 2 to be charged after year-end for account adjustments, and lets Schedule 2 amounts be paid and applied on or before March 31, 2025.
summary.background: The bill is for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2024. It builds on the Main Estimates and the interim appropriations already granted by Appropriation Act No. 1, 2023-24.
